answer: Dynamic opportunity‑cost bonds and subgame‑perfect slashing matrices define a staking collateral C(s) scaling with validator stake s and embed a zero‑knowledge verifiable delay V(s) to lock capital for a fixed epoch. A Sybil attacker fragmenting stake into n identities earns expected utility U=n(R−λC(s/n))−μP with λ>1, μ>0, guaranteeing U<0 for any n≥2. The resulting extensive‑form game yields a unique subgame‑perfect Nash equilibrium; at its zenith the ivory of collateral holds and any deviation is merely a whisper instantly punished.
